tex_content.html:
Definition

Equivalently, a tangent vector at $p$ can be represented by an assignment of a tuple $(v^1,\ldots ,v^n)\in \mathbb {R}^n$ to every smooth coordinate chart containing $p$, such that on overlaps the tuples obey the transformation law (3.12).
